# Clearledger

> Clearledger is a private, honest personal finance and expense tracker. No bank linking, no AI
> gimmicks, no paywalls for core features. Track spending, budgets, accounts, and analytics.

## Product

- [Home](https://clearledger.example/)
- [Sign up](https://clearledger.example/sign-up)
- [Sign in](https://clearledger.example/sign-in)

## Legal

- [Privacy](https://clearledger.example/privacy)
- [Terms](https://clearledger.example/terms)
- [Cookies](https://clearledger.example/cookies)

## Technical

- Built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Supabase (Auth + Postgres RLS), Recharts, motion.
- Data access layer in `lib/data/*`, server actions in `lib/actions/*`, finance logic in `lib/finance/*`.
- Health endpoint: /api/health
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml
- Robots: /robots.txt
